The '''Mantilorr system''' was a part of the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the entities known as [[Mantilorrian rat-catcher]]s.<ref name="FF73">{{FactFile|73|CRU 1-4|Salacious Crumb}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Mantilorrian rat-catcher]]|system=Mantilorr [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mantilorr [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, which placed it in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process, its [[canon]]icity within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity was never confirmed.<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed the system in grid square S-10,<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book ultimately overrode the ''Voyages SF'' placement by instead establishing that the Mantilorr system was part of the Suolriep [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />
